ctnhenergy.ponder.budding_quartz_grow.te: Budding quartz grows crystals over time
During growth, the budding quartz may degrade one tier (except flawless)
Place growth accelerators to speed up growth (they stack)
This is a budding certus quartz block
Budding quartz appears with mysterious cubes in meteorites
Your budding quartz degraded to a quartz block?
Right-click with a budding quartz of the same tier for a 50% chance to upgrade it!
You can obtain flawless budding quartz this way!

ctnhenergy.ponder.crafting_parallel.head: Parallel Auto Crafting
ctnhenergy.ponder.crafting_parallel.text: Multiple pattern providers allow parallel crafting
Memory cards can copy and apply configurations, including pattern providers
Sneak-right-click the pattern provider with a memory card...
The pattern provider saves its pattern data to the memory card
Then right-click the target pattern provider with the memory card...
The memory card consumes blank patterns and copies the saved patterns to the target
Repeat this process to build parallelization
Building a CPU has certain rules...
The CPU must be a rectangular cuboid
A non-cuboid CPU will not form properly
The CPU needs at least one crafting storage
Other parts can be crafting units, monitors, storages, or co-processors

ctnhenergy.ponder.import_export_bus.text: Import and export buses directly insert and extract from the network
The export bus outputs items from the network to a target container
The import bus inputs items from a container into the network
ctnhenergy.ponder.interface_common.text_: The ME interface is the network's connection to the outside world
Items can be inserted directly into the network via the ME interface
It will request items from the network to fill its configured slots

ctnhenergy.ponder.molecular_assembler.te: You need to place it next to a pattern provider
It can automate crafting table, stonecutter, and smithing table recipes

ctnhenergy.ponder.pattern_provider.text_: Use a wrench to change the pattern provider's direction
When the network issues a crafting request...
The pattern provider outputs ingredients to adjacent containers
Completing a craft requires returning items to the network
So you need to build a return mechanism

ctnhenergy.ponder.quantum_network_bridge: Quantum network bridges can extend your network
A quantum ring requires 8 quantum rings and 1 quantum link chamber
Connect the ring to your network via the 4 ring blocks around the link chamber
Rings are used in pairs - place another ring structure at the remote location
Insert quantum entangled singularities (from the same pair) into both rings
A pair of quantum rings consumes a fixed 400 AE/t regardless of distance
